def maxWeight(pizzas):
    nums = sorted(pizzas)
    n = len(nums)
    days = n // 4
    odd_days = (days + 1) // 2
    even_days = days // 2
    total = 0
    right = n - 1
    for _ in range(odd_days):
        total += nums[right]
        right -= 1
    for _ in range(even_days):
        total += nums[right - 1]
        right -= 2
    return total
